The standalone standard-library program independently reconstructs facets and edges, checks exact rational cells and side counts, normalizes spherical areas, and reproduces the separate mean identity; its finite Monte Carlo is only corroborative. Generic exceptional normals have spherical measure zero.

value.rationale: The complete three-point Haar polygon-type probability law is a natural invariant of an Archimedean convex polyhedron with no central symmetry. The exact six-cell decomposition and independently verified expectation benchmark are substantive finite classification data, not a textbook restatement of the solid face count or a routine slight numerical improvement. The probability that a random central section is pentagonal exceeds one half, demonstrating a non-obvious distribution of section complexity. The general chamber method is acknowledged as prior mathematics.
